enabled.hb_stubs.c: new pselect() stub: bounded-poll (25 ms) wrapper over the device select() syscall; ignores sigmask

root_cause_why_stub.kernel: src/kernel/process.c D8.4: signal delivery for a process parked in a pipe read defers until the syscall completes; the kernel never returns EINTR
root_cause_why_stub.mechanism: make's classic jobserver blocks in read() on the token pipe expecting SIGCHLD->EINTR to wake it, but the token is written back by reap_children() which only runs after that read returns -> deadlock
root_cause_why_stub.fix: pselect()-based token acquisition over select() with a bounded interval: returns 0 periodically so make reaps children, recovers tokens, starts next job. 25 ms only bounds detection latency; token-ready waits are immediate (select returns when fd ready)
